text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I messed up...
Even though I warmed up properly~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No! It's not that big of a deal.
The injury itself is minor, too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Personally, I'm scared my body will get rusty, so I feel like heading right back to practice, but... mmmngh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Which of the following do you think I should be doing right now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
1. Light jogging!
2. Moderate strength training!
3. Low-impact pool exercises!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! That's not fair, Trainer!
Option four wasn't on the list!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She certainly had a point, but I carefully explained that taking a proper rest now would be far more beneficial.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see... That makes sense, then.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's disappointing, emotionally speaking, but...
I will make sure to take a proper rest...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fine Motion quietly
entered a period of rest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪ If it's just a minor injury,
it's definitely better to keep moving your body.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wonder if... I misjudged it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion offered a troubled smile,
and decided to focus entirely on resting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's head out to the grounds right away♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it really is better to keep moving♪
Let's take it easy and do our best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fine Motion gradually
returned to her training.
